routes.name: Varzia relics, as Knell Prime
routes.cost: 1 Aya a relic from Varzia, Rare Barrel, 12h build

rows.label: Aya
rows.note: 1 per relic; bank it before the window opens

groups.activity: buy the Knell Prime relics she stocks, 1 Aya each
groups.meta: only while Knell Prime is in Prime Resurgence

live.text: vaulted; only during her Prime Resurgence

rows.label: Knell Prime relics
rows.note: buy extra Barrel relics: every one carries it as the Rare

conditions: Her stock rotates away; relics and Aya you hold never expire.
Vaulted relics and the parts themselves still trade between players.
bonuses: Varzia is also in the Market's Prime Resurgence tab.

rows.label: Knell Prime Blueprint
rows.note: Lith B11 or Lith S14 or Meso N12 or Meso S13 or Meso V7 or Axi B5 or Axi P4 or Axi W3, Common: 25.33% Intact

rows.label: Knell Prime Barrel
rows.note: Lith K11 or Meso K5 or Neo K4 or Axi K7 or Axi K9 or Axi K10 or Axi K11, Rare: 10% Radiant

rows.label: Knell Prime Receiver
rows.note: Lith G6 or Meso A3 or Meso H4 or Meso K4 or Neo D7 or Axi S15, Uncommon: 20% Radiant; Lith K10 or Meso K6, Rare: 10% Radiant

conditions: Refine Rare relics to Radiant (100 Void Traces each); leave Blueprint relics Intact, since Radiant lowers their Common odds to 16.67%.
Mission rewards never drop Resurgence relics; Varzia is the only source.
bonuses: Pick a teammate's identical reward at the reward screen; they get 5 bonus Void Traces.
